Must the final rectangle of black cells be non‑empty, i.e., contain at least one cell, or is an all‑white grid (empty rectangle) allowed?
If the initial grid already contains black cells that are not aligned in a rectangular shape, is the answer automatically “No”, or may we repaint some of those black cells to white?

Are we allowed to change the color of cells that are already painted (i.e., turn a ‘#’ into white or a ‘.’ into black), or must we only assign colors to the ‘?’ cells while keeping existing colors fixed?
In the case where multiple rectangles could satisfy the condition, does it matter which one we choose, or is any rectangle sufficient as long as it matches the final coloring?
Should the output be exactly “Yes”/“No” with that capitalization and no extra whitespace or newline characters?
Are there any hidden limits on H and W beyond the stated 1 ≤ H, W ≤ 1000 that could affect memory or time constraints (e.g., total cells ≤ 10⁶)?
If the input contains leading or trailing spaces on each line, should they be ignored, or are they considered invalid input?

inline_prompts:
You are given a grid of H rows and W columns.  
Let (i,j) denote the cell at row i (1 \leq i \leq H) from the top and column j (1 \leq j \leq W) from the left.  
The state of the grid is represented by H strings S_1, S_2, \ldots, S_H, each of length W.  
Takahashi wants to paint each not-yet-painted cell white or black so that all the black cells form a rectangle.  
More precisely, he wants there to exist a quadruple of integers (a,b,c,d) (1 \leq a \leq b \leq H, 1 \leq c \leq d \leq W) such that:  
For each cell (i,j) (1 \leq i \leq H, 1 \leq j \leq W),  
if a \leq i \leq b and c \leq j \leq d, the cell is black;  
otherwise, the cell is white.  
Determine whether this is possible.  
Input  
The input is given from Standard Input in the following format:  
H W  
S_1  
S_2  
\vdots  
S_H  
Output  
If it is possible to paint all the not-yet-painted cells so that the black cells form a rectangle, print Yes; otherwise, print No.  
Constraints  
- 1 \leq H, W \leq 1000  
- H and W are integers.  
- Each S_i is a string of length W consisting of #, ., ?.  
# = black cell, . = white cell, ? = unpainted cell.
